notes: Parts are unchanged from step 1; no additions or removals.
Each LED has its own 220 ohm resistor on the anode side, from the Uno pin. Pins 6, 5, 4, 3, 2 go to LED 1 to LED 5. All cathodes return to GND through the top negative rail, as in the schematic.

Breadboard hole names follow the catalogue: rows a-e are bank 't' and rows f-j are bank 'b'. The picture draws rows j-f in the top half and a-e in the bottom half, so each hole uses the bank that matches its row letter.
Exact rail hole numbers (tn.2, 12, 15, 18, 21, 24) are estimated from the picture. The rail is one strip, so the choice does not change the circuit.
Uno GND is taken as GND.1, the GND pin next to AREF on the digital header.
Resistor legs straddle the centre gap: leg 1 in row f of the top half, leg 2 in row e of the bottom half. The blue wire lands in row d of the same column.
LED anode is the longer leg, on the resistor side (left column of each pair). The cathode is the right column, joined by a black wire to the ground rail.
The USB cable to the computer is not drawn, so it is not included.
